faq: How do I give you access to the code?

Invite us to your Git repository with limited rights and send the build steps. We work on a branch and never touch your main branch. Signing keys and Play Console access are only needed if you ask us to release.
Do you work in Java or Kotlin?
Both. We follow the language your app already uses and write new code in Kotlin where that is allowed. We do not convert your whole project unless you order a migration.
Can you fix crashes reported in Google Play Console?
Yes, if you share the Android vitals reports or stack traces. We trace the cause and fix it, or tell you what extra logging we need if the data is thin.
Will the change work on older phones and different brands?
We test on the Android versions and screen sizes you list. Android has many makers, so very unusual devices cannot all be covered, but we aim for the common ones.
